summary_ja: 最低要件を満たさない場合に、内部格付手法の使用が不適当と判断したときは承認を取り消せることを定める。
summary_en: Allows the Commissioner to revoke the approval where minimum requirements are not met and use of the internal ratings-based approach is judged inappropriate.
paragraphs: The Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency may revoke the approval under Article 116 where, in the case listed in item (iii) of paragraph (1) of the preceding Article, the Commissioner judges it inappropriate to calculate the amount of credit risk-weighted assets using the internal ratings-based approach.
